verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents a dedicated non-interactive, headless mode for its official CLI that skips saved configuration and sessions, explicitly aimed at automating tasks on CI servers (appwrite-docs-42/67). The CLI covers the operations you would automate: managing projects, rows, files and users, and creating and deploying Functions (appwrite-docs-12). The --endpoint flag lets the same headless automation target self-hosted instances (appwrite-docs-22). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and no documented CI-platform examples (e.g. GitHub Actions).
